source: hand-written for offline contract tests in this repository
statement: These fixtures are NOT recordings of any Java service, platform, MQTT topic or device. They exist only to exercise accept/reject branches of the typed contracts. No credential, token, device serial or business record is included.
wire_format_note: Receipt wire values follow the existing lingxi-command-receipt/v1 field set (completed/failed/unknown/expired/conflict). 'succeeded' is only a canonical Agent-side name; it is not accepted on the wire because no verified platform field uses it.

verified_against.note: No real platform or device verification was performed for these contracts.
